title: healthz reports the deployed commit and wait-run compares it
evidence: Split from T3 on 2026-11-13 (owner's ruling): app/routes/healthz.ts answers only {"status":"ok"}, so a 200 from an old machine counts as healthy in tools/wait-run.sh deploy. Needs a design for the owner first: where the sha comes from at build time, both Fly apps, and the public route adds only the commit id; then wait-run compares it with the run's head sha. US-64 AC26
